process.commandLine: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$f = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'counter.txt'; $n = if (Test-Path $f) { [int](Get-Content $f) + 1 } else { 1 }; Set-Content $f $n; $os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; 'exec #{0} | computer {1} | booted {2}' -f $n, $env:COMPUTERNAME, $os.LastBootUpTime; Add-Content 'C:\path\to\mxc\learn\05-windows-sandbox-state-aware\work\log.txt' ('exec #{0} at {1} on {2}' -f $n, (Get-Date -Format HH:mm:ss), $env:COMPUTERNAME)"
